name: snapset
title: Snapset
description: Save and restore complete Mac workspaces, including apps, windows, macOS Spaces, browser tabs, and Finder folders
author: seiya_nishi

commands.name: apply-layout
commands.title: Apply Layout
commands.subtitle: Snapset
commands.description: Restore a workspace saved in Snapset. Snapset reopens missing apps, restores windows to their saved positions across displays and macOS Spaces, reopens saved browser tabs and Finder folders, and can hide apps that are not part of the workspace.

commands.name: save-layout
commands.title: Save Layout
commands.subtitle: Snapset
commands.description: Save your current Mac workspace as a new Snapset layout. Snapset captures the apps and windows in use, their positions across displays and macOS Spaces, open browser tabs, and Finder folders.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
